newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rival cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rival cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Dean Witter Reynolds analyst William Steele said Friday he downgraded his rating on Rival Co to neutral from buy and reduced his earnings estimates after the company took a charge and posted a loss of $0.44 per share for the March 31 third quarter.
-- Steele said he slashed his EPS projections for FY97 to $1.20 from $1.90. "In the Q3 we were looking for $0.22 per share positive operating earnings, and they came in at $0.24 negative," he said.
-- Rival cited high inventories, excess plant capacity and low seasonal production. Rival was off 6-3/4 at 14-5/8.
